label: Intellect only in material things is an alternative to immateriality as the ground of intellect
note: Same ComposedOfMatterAndForm, HasIntellect and ComponentOf. The rival is strictly stronger than the premise's negation. Model-witnessed alongside the other premises of godHasIntellect; neither is established and no refutation is recorded. Objection audit 2026-11-12 (attempt b6384b6b-ef1a-405e-8237-0c2127d86b5f): partial: Papineau's causal-power physicalism supports at most 'intellect requires the physical', with the bridge from physical to matter-form composite open; nothing on file supports the second conjunct, an altogether immaterial thing without intellect. A further partial objection on file is not this rival: Plotinus V.4.2 argues that intellect is two, so the absolutely simple first is not intellect; the sense bridge from the Plotinian intellect (DEF-PLOTINIAN-INTELLECT-DUALITY) to HasIntellect is open.
